data_window: GitHub Search API queries for AI agent, LLM app, RAG, MCP, browser agent, code agent, voice agent, workflow, copilot, and assistant repositories created or pushed from 2026-09-06 through 2026-09-09. Raw search snapshots were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_09_api/; selected repository metadata, root-content and README audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_09_readmes/.
source_summary: Queried 9 GitHub Search API surfaces and deduplicated 433 repositories. Reviewed metadata, topics, root files, README headings, package/Docker/test clues, install paths, docs, examples, plugin folders, desktop/mobile paths, and runtime claims for 42 shortlisted repositories. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, executed, browser-tested, mobile-tested, provider-tested, credential-tested, payment-tested, safety-tested, or deployed locally.
trend_observations: Agent operations infrastructure dominated this window: context compression, code graphs, memory, transcript capture, worktree management, and session runtimes. Coding-agent products are moving from single CLI tools toward fleet control surfaces with desktop/mobile orchestration, agent teams, remote daemons, and browser supervision. Browser/computer-use products increasingly emphasize state isolation and logged-in context sharing, but safety and credential-boundary claims need verification. Design, media, and pipeline tools are becoming agent-addressable artifact workbenches rather than passive editors. Star counts were unusually high across several new repositories, so scoring confidence leans on root/README/product evidence more than raw popularity.
assumptions: Scores are based on GitHub API metadata and README/root-content evidence collected on 2026-09-09, not local runtime proof. Star/fork counts are raw GitHub API values at collection time; no authenticated traffic, release-download, or star-delta API was used. Runnability is inferred from package files, Docker/config files, docs, examples, tests, and quick-start sections. Mature incumbents, canonical vendor products, awesome lists, skill/prompt collections, pure benchmarks, and yesterday's picks were downgraded or skipped.
markdown_report: Top focus for 2026-09-09: agent-driven design workbenches, context compression, local code graphs, terminal coding agents, multi-agent orchestration, coding-agent runtimes, provider-specific coding CLIs, Codex workflow hooks, cross-device agent orchestration, and isolated browser state for agents. Watchlist covers portable agent memory, AI pipeline AIDEs, worktree managers, homelab AI servers, desktop real-work agents, agent OS evolution loops, and agent transcript history. Skip reasons cover yesterday's already-published picks, mature incumbents, canonical vendor products, awesome/list repositories, skill packages, and suspicious raw popularity surfaces.

top_projects.summary: Local-first desktop and web design environment where coding agents can produce prototypes, dashboards, slides, images, video, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 exports, and design-system artifacts.
top_projects.audience: Product teams and AI-coding users who want design artifacts generated and iterated from agent sessions.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Treats the coding agent as the design engine, with BYOK model routing and compatibility claims across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, and related CLIs.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-04-28 and pushed 2026-09-09; GitHub API showed 95,054 stars and 10,994 forks. Root audit found apps, packages, plugins, e2e, design templates, docs, changelog, quickstart, and privacy docs.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from repository shape and docs; local model, export, and desktop flows were not executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Inspect export boundaries and how agent-authored design files are versioned before using it for production-facing artifacts.

top_projects.summary: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM, offered as library, proxy, and MCP server.
top_projects.audience: Teams running long coding-agent sessions that hit context-window, cost, or noisy-tool-output limits.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Adds a runtime layer between tools and model calls, preserving important error lines and structured facts while reducing prompt load.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-01-07 and pushed 2026-09-09; GitHub API showed 70,949 stars and 5,439 forks. Root audit found Dockerfile, docker-compose, Cargo/Python packages, examples, docs, tests, env examples, security tooling, and demo assets.
top_projects.runnability: High from install and test clues; compression quality and provider behavior were not independently benchmarked.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run against this radar pipeline's verbose tool logs and measure recall on fatal lines, counts, and file paths.

top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from CLI, tests, and install docs; no local index was built in this run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Compare retrieval output against existing rg workflows on one large repo before granting persistent indexing access.
